notes.title: Collections Update
notes.notes:
[b]The long awaited collections update just dropped! See what items you are still missing and get a glimpse on what items await you.
[/b]

I also added two more supporter items! Thanks to everyone playing and supporting this <3
Check them out here [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/3419430/]item store[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45392114/c9ef8e31a923c7728a0f4099c46c08b2a1870780.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] New UI
[*] Collections
[*] Special items for people who joined the Discord and Followed the game on Steam
[*] Picture mode now works again and stores the pictures via Steam instead of copying them to the clipboard
[*] Fixed inventory not resizing after exchange
[*] Abbreviated inventory stacks above 1000 with 1k

notes.title: Bug Fixes & New Features
notes.notes:
- Adds a picture mode (F12) to get a clean cutout picture of your cat!
- Admin mode detection works now for all languages
- Option to select 3 preset locations for the chest timer
- Auto slot all duplicates for quicker exchanges
- Indicator if you have enough duplicates to exchange them to a new item
- Hotkey to flip your cat (F)
- Adds an error popup if Steam connection is disrupted and tells you what to do :D
- Auto randomizer which changes your cats looks every X minutes
- Vsync settings
- Several bug fixes related to the inventory not updating correctly after exchanging
- Option to reset your current taps (doesn't reset your achievement)
- Total lifetime taps info in the settings menu

Just a small update before the new items drop!

notes.title: Bug fixes & Red Cross Fix
notes.notes:
- Adds tooltips explaining the settings
- Adds option to disable the bobbing animation
- Removes scales that are not applyable
- Shows timer in the beginning longer
- Adds a rarity border to the new item popup
- Revert controller changes (should now work again consistently)
- Fixes a bug that the game crashes if your system language is Arabic
- Should fix the red cross now (finally), this can cause random drops sometimes (if your timer desynced with the Steam timer), so enjoy them <3
- Saves the cooldown if you restart the game
- Removes admin mode if current user has no admin priviledges
- Makes autostart noninteractable if admin mode is enabled (not possible in windows to have both)
- only shows chest popup if you have 1000 clicks

If you have the admin mode enabled and it's bugged this is how you can disable it:
Right click the game on steam -> Manage -> Browse local files
there right click the BongoCat.exe -> properties -> go to the compatibility tab -> uncheck the "run as administrator" checkbox, hit apply
Start Bongo Cat

On another note:
Currently working on new items and a small event :eyes:

notes.title: QoL, Bug Fixes and Trading Changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone 👋

WHAT A LAUNCH, thanks to everyone playing! I love to read all your messages in the morning <3

Over 150.000 people played the game already, that is INSANE!!!

[b]I now gathered multiple issues and changed a few things:
[/b][list]
[*]Fixes a bug that screen boundaries are ignored and your mouse could move to another screen
[*]Fixes that your game tabs out if you hover over the cat in a fullscreen game
[*]Adds the "Admin Mode" you need to opt-in this will make Bongo Cat start as admin, which solves a lot of issues regarding clicks not getting tracked in several games!
[*]Adds a quit button, yeah i know, long overdue, but why would you quit Bongo Cat :(
[/list]

[b]And now to one of the more controversial changes: i just removed trading between two users (NOT THE MARKET, THIS STILL WORKS). I noticed bot accounts farming thousands of items and by moving the items to one single account and then selling a ton of them in bulk. To prevent this i now removed trading between two users this will make their lifes harder (i hope).[/b]
This doesn't mean that this is permanent but i want to ensure that everybody has a good time, if i can handle the bots then i will try to bring this back <3 Thanks for your understanding!


If you read this: the gaming mode disables all interactions until a chest is ready, i added this so you can focus on your game and still collect the rewards and not accidently clicking on things. Hope this clarifies a few things.

[b]A small list of things i will add soon:[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support is still WIP, it's way harder than i anticipated so please stay tuned <3
[*] Sounds (but opt-in)
[*] New items
[*] Fixing the annoying red cross, i finally know the reason: the moment Steam detects you as "away" it will mess with the item drops...already talking to them to see if this can be fixed and how :)
[*] And all the bugs that come up
[/list]

[b]And regarding the special demo items (if you are eligable you can still do this for a few more days, then the demo will become unavailable, so be quick!):[/b]
1. Restart Steam
2. Reinstall the demo (the small Download demo button on main store page)
3. Start the Demo
4. Start the full game

Best
Your pigeon gruu gruu <3

notes.title: Release Date Announcement - March 5th
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who played the demo, gave feedback, shared their cats and found bugs. It's amazing to see how well the game is being received <3

I can finally share the release date with everyone: [b]March 5, 9:00AM CET[/b]. So only a few more days to go!

[b]Quick info to everyone:[/b]
Your hats in the demo will not carry over to the full game, Steam doesn't allow that.
But everyone who played the demo will receive two exclusive items. The items will not be available via chests, so there will only be a limited number. They are legendary by definition (because there are only a few of them).

[b]You must have 30min of playtime in the demo to be eligible for the drop.
[/b]
I will show you the items in the next few days :)

Until then, have fun with the demo!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest will start tomorrow and Bongo Cat will be a part of it!
The game is close to launch so one final push for the demo :)


[b]Quick patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds exchanges (10 items of the same rarity can be upgraded to one of a higher tier)
[*] Your cat can't escape your screen anymore! If you move it out of bounds it will auto reset itself :)
[*] Adds cat skins
[*] Adds over 50 new items
[*] Increase the drop timer to 30min (sorry, but i need to do that to hopefully fix the red cross)
[*] Adds some info regarding F-Keys to the settings screen
[*] Adds the "game mode" which will make the cat non interactable until a chest drops
[*] Adds new and equipped (highlighting the item currently equipped and which items are new in the inventory, sorry for the initial click fest :D )
[*] Adds backup save games, this should auto restore your progress if it fails to load the current one
[*] Many more bug fixes
[/list]


And many many thanks to all of you! For your feedback, reviews and wholesome screenshots!
I really appreciate you all playing and also liking your small work buddy <3


Lets rock this Steam Next Fest!!!

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
My demo has just been released for the Steam Idle Fest tonight.

The items in the demo are not tradable. In the full version of the game, you can trade and sell any cosmetic item you drop.

You will get an exlusive and free item if you've played the demo!

The Gamer hat:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FiUJbyj.png[/img]

You get this item by playing the demo and once the full game launches, play it once, then you will drop this exclusive item.
